description.value: Persia Foods is a family-owned grocery chain that has served the Lower Mainland since 1996, positioning itself as Vancouver's most affordable source for fresh, healthy, and ethnically diverse foods. With multiple locations across Metro Vancouver including two in North Vancouver, it offers touring cyclists a culturally rich resupply option with a wide variety of international and everyday grocery staples. The chain is locally rooted and welcomes both local and global producers, giving it a broad and varied product selection.
